yet more JSDoc updates: "event" and "fires", more types (#28)

- added "event" and "fires" tags to EDDNClient, ReconnectingWebSocket
- added more type specifiers

Eventually, Github needs a new code category: 30% Javascript, 70% JSDoc

Start async data fetches on `await ready` instead of automatically (#23)

This prevents uncaught errors if the load fails. It should never happen.
main.js logs an error and aborts. Drawing an error message in the HTML view is left for a later design pass.

Semi-breaking change: CachedPageIconActivity, Dashboard and RegionMap no longer begin the fetch automatically. Awaiting ready is now required.

Garbage Reduction Part 1.5: Suspend `#render()` for tables out of view (#22)

- Track each module's table visibility through an `IntersectionObserver` (in `Dashboard`)
- Pause/resume the `#render()` call per module (in `DashboardModule`)
- Schedule a refresh for the next animation frame when rendering resumes

This should reduce the amount of DOM nodes needlessly created in tables that are not in view (e.g. the event log scrolled out of view). The table should immediately refresh when it scrolls back into view.

Garbage Reduction Part 1 (#14)

**Breaking Change: The way `_handleEvent()` queues content via `addRow()` changed.**

When the page is not on active display and the browser suspends the `requestAnimationFrame()` callback timer, the data table modules still created and discarded many thousands of DOM nodes per day.

With this change, most nodes are now created in the `#render()` callback.

- the modules now queue data with `this._addRow({ event, cells: [cell1TextContent, cell2Node, () => cell3Callback(), ... ]})`
- passing `event` in the object is required boilerplate to allow a later `_makeRow()` call
- special nodes are still created for each message, e.g. the longest jump range in `NavRouteModule` that conditionally adds a "longjump" CSS class
- a callback can create a node at render time, e.g. the uploaderID-cell in `EventLogModule`

The WeakMap in InfoBox was replaced with a Symbol-key on the row element referencing the event data.

Finally update websockets to "new" asyncio (#11)

The WebsocketRelay class was needlessly using the legacy asyncio websockets implementation.
This version should be compatible with Python websockets >= 10.0

A specialized version of websockets.broadcast() was added as WebsocketRelay._broadcast(message: bytes | str) to avoid recoding bytes to str and back to bytes.

The Big JS Rewrite (#10)

* * Everything changes

** Settings in `config.js`
- WebSocket URL
- idle/reset timers
- `globalEventFilter` - optional message filter function, return truthy to pass, falsy to drop messages
  - example: `globalEventFilter: (event) => (event.StarSystem.startsWith("HIP ") || event.message?.Route?.some((wp) => wp?.StarSystem?.startsWith("HIP ")))`

** `Dashboard`
- each "box" is created and updated by a module instance
- modules subscribe to a MessageRouter (e.g. "navroute", "journal:scan", "*")
- initial page laylout created from `<div data-dashboard__module="...">` placeholders in `index.html`
- vague future plans:
  - run-time configuration overlay for layouts, sizes, module options
  - non-table content: plot events on a map, graph averages, ...
  - create the page layout from URL or local storage
  - import modules dynamically
  - go full XSS and import custom modules from URLs?

** Templates
- `<template>` definitions are now in "templates.en.html", currently the only locale supported
- vague future plans:
  - support multiple languages with fallback
  - define full row templates, fill "slots" by the modules to enable the template to define field order
  - non-table templates

** EDDN Websocket and Messages
- `EDDNClient` connects the websocket, parses incoming JSON and dispatches `EDDNEvent("eddn:message")` to listeners
  - a global message filter function can be defined
- `EDDNEvent.eventType` set from schema URL ("navroute"), "journal" adds event name from message ("journal:fsdjump")
- `MessageRouter` delivers events to subscribed modules by eventType
- vague future plan: optional SharedWorker to provide websocket/parsing service for multiple tabs

** `RegionMap` based on [EliteDangerousRegionMap](https://github.com/klightspeed/EliteDangerousRegionMap)
- `findRegion(x, _y, z)` - find region `{ id, name }` from x/z coordinates
- changes:
  - flattening the inner `Array` array into rows of ints speeds up the lookup almost 2x
  - memory-size/parse-time micro-optimization: converted from JSON to binary ArrayBuffer

** More Changes

*** Status icons cached as blob-URLs
- this should avoid re-fetching icons over the network on state changes

*** `ReconnectingWebSocket` re-vibed
- [Joe's](https://github.com/joewalnes/reconnecting-websocket) version still works perfectly but this looks more modern now, is an `EventTarget` itself, dispatches the proper event classes, etc.
- code tokenized by an LLM prompted to provide a `WebSocket` wrapper that would re-connect dropped connections automatically
- probably useless/potentially harmful feature: respond to network offline/online events
  - an unstable network could possibly cause frequent handshakes/drops for the websocket server
  - makes the class depend on and attach listeners to global `window`

*** StatsBox lives on
- `StatsBox` and `SortedStatsBox` don't quite fit into the modular system
- possible candidates for further rework

** Lost Features
*** "Last timestamp" and "Max jump range" removed from game statistics
- potential run-time efficiency: without these two, all tracked values are (small integer) numbers
- the NavRoute module currently has no way to update the record
  - dispatch events / update shared stats map / run the route distance loop twice?
